article_title: 别让 InMemory 冒充 EF Core 翻译证明
core_theme: 通过的测试只证明它断言的那一层：谓词含义、应用接线、EF Core 翻译与生产库语义是三种不同证据，只有真提供程序上的测试才能跨过翻译边界
reader_takeaway: 知道每条规范测试该放在哪一层，以及哪些命题必须落到真实数据库的提供程序契约测试上
summary_angle: 一张绿色的通过标记被安放在内存层，但它的支撑结构并没有接到数据库；同一个表达式要继续往下，就必须穿过一条真正打印出 SQL 的窄通道，在通道另一端才能拿到翻译证据

information_blocks.source_anchor: 开头：一个用 Compile() 编出来的谓词在内存里返回了正确的 true，但同一份条件交给生产库时翻译失败、排序规则不同
information_blocks.visual_idea: 最上层一个绿色勾选标记悬在一只内存盒子之上，盒子下方没有连到任何数据库

information_blocks.source_anchor: 应用接缝小节：接缝应返回物化结果而不是 IQueryable<T>，用例只负责构造并传出规范
information_blocks.visual_idea: 中间一层是一条手绘的分类流水线，几张卡片沿箭头被送往一个标注为接缝的网关

information_blocks.source_anchor: 关系型执行与生产提供程序契约小节：只有关系型提供程序真的接收并执行表达式，才出现 EF Core 翻译这个命题
information_blocks.visual_idea: 底层是一条窄通道，通道口吐出一行带 LIKE 的短 SQL 片段，通道另一端立着一台抽屉式数据库机柜，柜上贴着绿色勾选

main_metaphor: 三层堆叠的证明结构：绿色通过标记挂在最上面的内存层，而唯一通向数据库机柜的窄通道开在最底部
primary_subject: 一台三层堆叠的手绘证明装置，顶层挂着绿色勾选，底层机柜旁吐出 SQL 片段
subject_action: 同一份查询条件从顶层往下推进，在底层穿过窄通道后到达数据库机柜，机柜旁才出现翻译成功的勾选
selected_style_prompt_descriptor: indie comic illustration, personal hand-drawn marks, muted palette, imperfect line texture, intimate editorial feeling
selected_style_reason: 用户未指定风格，本篇从风格池随机选中；测试层级错配是一个认知问题，独立漫画的手绘质感和克制配色适合表达这种判断，而不是渲染成光鲜的科技海报
style_safety_note: 清单风格为泛类型描述，不涉及品牌、工作室或艺术家复刻
draft_goal: 验证「三层证明结构 + 顶部内存层与数据库断开 + 只有底层机柜旁拿到真 SQL 证据」这条摘要弧线是否一眼可读
revision_targets: 分层之间的断开关系是否可见（顶部托盘与下层之间用红色断开标记）
三层结构是否一眼可数、且占满画面不显空
SQL 片段是否短到读不出伪造细节，且不出现整句英文
final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: testing C# and EF Core specifications at the right proof level. The reader should quickly feel that a green passing test only proves the layer it actually asserts.
Phase note: this is a fresh generation, not an edit of any previous image.

Summary angle: three clearly separated proof layers stack diagonally from upper left to lower right, and each layer owns its own passing check; the top in-memory layer shows a green check even though nothing connects it to any database, and only the bottom layer, which reaches a drawer-style database cabinet through a narrow channel, carries a check that came from real SQL.
Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 3 supporting narrative beats, fill the frame so the apparatus spans most of the width, and leave only modest breathing room. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration.
Information blocks:
- problem: a shallow open tray reads clearly as an in-memory store, holding one small memory module and two paper criteria cards, with a green check hovering over it and no cable, pipe, or ramp leaving the tray downward; visible label 内存谓词
- mechanism: a hand-drawn sorting chute carries three small cards along arrows into a compact gateway box; visible label 接缝接线
- takeaway: a narrow channel leaves the gateway box, emits one very short SQL fragment, and ends at a drawer-style database cabinet that has its own green check beside it; visible label 真库 SQL

Main metaphor: a three-tier stacked proof apparatus where the passing mark hangs at the top in-memory tier, while the only passage to the database cabinet opens at the very bottom.
Subject: a hand-drawn three-tier proof apparatus, with a green check on the top in-memory tier and a database cabinet at the bottom tier.
Composition/framing: slight diagonal progression from upper left to lower right; the three tiers are close enough to read as one connected machine while still clearly countable; one dominant focal subject; legible in a wide 2.35:1 frame.
Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: indie comic illustration, personal hand-drawn marks, muted palette, imperfect line texture, intimate editorial feeling. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: warm off-white paper background, deep ink linework, one muted grass-green accent for the passing checks, one restrained brick-red accent used only on the gap between the top tier and the layer below it.
Visible text policy: allow only 3 short Chinese labels sourced from the information blocks: 内存谓词, 接缝接线, 真库 SQL. Each label must be no longer than 6 Chinese characters. The single SQL fragment may show only a very short abbreviated token such as LIKE with a placeholder, never a full statement. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: neon skyscrapers, green code rain, floating chips, generic robot poses, dense HUD overlays, piles of shields and padlocks, realistic product UI screenshots, any human figure, large empty paper areas.
